T: One toy left. One very long Christmas Eve.
D: A workaholic dad races around the city on Christmas Eve to find the year's must-have action figure.
P: Serve the snacks when Howard hits the toy store on Christmas Eve.
S: Gingerbread dough rolled thin, cut into little men, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, piped with white icing buttons. Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120g golden syrup. Stir into 375g flour, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and 3 tsp ground ginger with 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut 20 men. Bake at 180C for 9 minutes, cool and pipe buttons with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.
the too-perfect neighbour always popping over

Crisp vanilla butter cookies cut into stars and trees, iced with flawless white royal icing and finished with silver cachous and sprinkles. Beat 200g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 350g plain flour and a pinch of salt, chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut stars and trees. Bake at 180C for 9 minutes and cool. Beat 1 egg white with 250g icing sugar and lemon juice to thick icing, pipe outlines, flood the centres and decorate with cachous and sprinkles.
the Christmas parade at the end
Popcorn tossed in white chocolate with red and green sprinkles and a pinch of salt, spread on a tray to set.
M: the family Christmas in the Minnesota cold

Leg ham scored and glazed with maple, mustard and orange, roasted sticky and dark, with buttery mash, honey carrots and a cranberry relish. Heat the oven to 180C. Peel the rind off a 3kg cooked half leg ham, score the fat in diamonds and stud with cloves. Simmer 125ml maple syrup, 2 tbsp Dijon, the juice of an orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 3 minutes. Roast the ham for 50 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Serve with mash, carrots roasted in honey and cranberry sauce stirred with orange zest.
the neighbour who always gets there first

Beef mince and onion in a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with tater tots and cheddar, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp. Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 250ml cream and simmer until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g frozen tater tots and 100g cheddar and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp.
W: Dark chocolate spread thin, set, covered with white chocolate and crushed candy canes, set again and broken into shards.
K: Christmas Eve at home, finally, Turbo-Man in hand

Rich vanilla eggnog of yolks, milk and cream cooked gently with cinnamon, nutmeg and a little maple, chilled and topped with whipped cream. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 80g caster sugar until pale. Heat 500ml milk and 250ml cream with a cinnamon stick and a grating of nutmeg until steaming. Whisk into the yolks, return to the pan and stir over low heat to 75C until it coats the spoon. Strain, stir in 1 tbsp maple syrup and 1 tsp vanilla, and chill 4 hours. Serve topped with whipped cream and more nutmeg.
